recognize_zh: 骨髓切片高倍中央可見一顆大型組織球，細胞質充滿粉紅色、細長針狀或條紋狀的包涵物，核被擠向一側，背景為大量未成熟顆粒球系細胞，配合 CML 診斷為假性高雪氏細胞。
features: Large histiocyte with abundant cytoplasm packed with pink, needle-like to striated fibrillary inclusions
A second, less distinct striated histiocyte adjacent below
Background of immature myeloid cells with oval vesicular nuclei and granular cytoplasm
Scattered eosinophilic granulocytes and segmented forms
describe_en: High-power bone marrow trephine biopsy shows a large histiocyte with abundant cytoplasm filled with pink, needle-like to striated fibrillary material and a small eccentric nucleus, with a second similar cell nearby. The background consists of densely packed immature and maturing granulocytic cells, including eosinophilic forms. No organisms are evident. Findings are consistent with pseudo-Gaucher cells in chronic myeloid leukemia; crystal-storing histiocytosis is less likely given the myeloid background.

ddx.vs: Crystal-storing histiocytes contain rhomboid or needle-shaped immunoglobulin crystals with light-chain restriction in a plasma cell or lymphoplasmacytic neoplasm.
Gaucher cells look identical but occur without a BCR::ABL1-positive myeloproliferative background and are confirmed by enzyme assay.
Mycobacteria-laden histiocytes appear striated but are acid-fast positive.
